overview: This single-page file consists of a State Department list-of-papers sheet for the subject “Aerial navigation—Kwantung Leased Territory.” Dated March 30, 1931, it records one item: a March 4 report from Dairen, associated with an officer whose OCR-rendered name is “Caville,” sent to “FE” and concerning aviation in the leased territory during 1930; the report itself is not present in the supplied text.

people.name: Caville
people.role: Officer associated with the indexed report from Dairen; precise position not stated

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning aviation in the Kwantung Leased Territory
subfiles.about: An index sheet records a March 4 report to “FE” on aviation in the Kwantung Leased Territory during 1930.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies the file subject as aerial navigation in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It lists a single March 4 item from Dairen—the place misread by OCR as “Lafren”—associated with “Caville” and addressed to “FE.” The indexed report covered aviation in the territory for 1930, but its substantive text is absent from this bundle.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as evidence of a now-absent or separately filed report on aviation in the Japanese-administered Kwantung Leased Territory. Its date, origin, recipient abbreviation, and concise description may help historians trace the underlying report elsewhere in Record Group 59 and reconstruct State Department monitoring of aviation around Dairen in 1930.
